### This is 1.1.0 release build for 1.20.3-1.20.4. It has no functional changes compared to previous one.
### 1.20.5 build is not planned so far. If you need it, please leave a request on GitHub.

---
For a year I wasn't sure what to do with this mod. Luckily, I got the first (and **good**) feature suggestion so I found a reason to update this mod.
With some internals being rewritten, it's time for **new release**!

### Changelog

- Added support for written books

  ![book](https://github.com/SyberiaK/colorful-hex/blob/release/1.20.3-1.20.4/media/book.png?raw=true)

- Added support for tooltips (thanks @ExiledLizard, #1)

  ![tooltip](https://github.com/SyberiaK/colorful-hex/blob/release/1.20.3-1.20.4/media/tooltip.png?raw=true)

- Now supported by Minecraft 1.20-1.20.4
- Now **requires** Fabric API to work
